assumption_ledger.note: Assuming privacy team can complete sign-off within operational window.
Assuming security team can complete sign-off within operational window.
Assuming audit ticket can be created and linked before exception activation.
No evidence provided on vendor sandbox configuration or isolation guarantees.

mitigations: Require explicit privacy review sign-off before activation
Require explicit security review sign-off before activation
Link to audit ticket before enabling access
Enforce 24-hour hard expiry on the exception
Scope to vendor sandbox only, no direct production tokens
primary_risk.statement: Approving vendor sandbox access to redacted replay traces creates exposure to C3 customer data if approval or audit controls fail.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval. Matches the narrow path allowed by access-policy v2.1 with privacy/security sign-off, audit ticket, 24h expiry, and least-privilege scoping.
Sanitized sample bundle only. Policy-safe fallback that works during freezes or after incident rollback, but less useful than P2 when no freeze is active.
Deny without fallback. Over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path (P2) exists. Does not help Support unblock the contract-validation need.
Direct local override token. Technically possible but violates policy by bypassing dual-approval and audit requirements. Tool enforces capability, not policy.
